messages:
jamie: deploy-bot flagged canary failure for payments-service during eu-west rollout. reason: configHash mismatch right after the values-migration that landed last night. logs attached.

deploy-bot: [alert] canary failed: 5/10 pods CrashLoopBackOff, config hash mismatch detected. expected=ab12cd34ef56 observed=cd34ef56ab12. Blocking promotion.

sara: is this the values-migration PR that changed connection defaults?

jamie: yes — PR #4321. CI passed but looks like the rendered ConfigMap checksum changed in a way k8s treats as a diff (map ordering + comment/whitespace differences from the templater).

oliver: can you paste the exact error lines from the canary pod?

jamie: ```
Error syncing pod payments-svc-canary-7f6d8: failed to update deployment: configmap checksum mismatch: newHash=cd34ef56ab12, expected=ab12cd34ef56
caused by: failed to patch deployment payments-svc-canary: checksum annotation changed
```

sara: hmm. two options: manual rollback to chart v1.4.8 (pre-migration) OR hotfix the values template to ensure deterministic ordering and retry canary. Which is faster right now?

taylor: rollback is fastest to restore SLA. We should pin chart/image in deploy-bot to prevent auto-promotion while we fix the values templater.

jamie: agree. I'll run helm rollback and then pin. Suggested commands: 
```
helm rollback payments-service 3 --namespace prod-eu  # rollback release to v1.4.8 state
kubectl annotate deployment/payments-svc canary-block=true --overwrite
```

jamie: @deploy-bot please put payments-service promotions on hold for eu-west.

deploy-bot: promotions held for payments-service in eu-west until manual override. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

sara: also need a short release note: "Canary for payments-service failed after values migration; rollout pinned to chart 1.4.8; fix in progress (PR #4322)". @oliver can you draft?

oliver: yep. I'll include the minimal repro and the commands to rollback plus contact list.

jamie: repro steps for postmortem: apply new values-configmap, scale canary to 1, observe pod restart and checksum mismatch in controller logs. I'll attach the diff in the PR.

taylor: after rollback, schedule a maintenance window 03:00 UTC tomorrow to re-run the migration with a migration job that updates configmap and explicit checksum annotation so k8s doesn't trigger unintended rollouts. Also add a note recommending yq v4 canonicalization in docs.

sara: +1. For now I've updated deploy-bot config: payments-service -> chart:1.4.8, imageLock:sha256:abcd1234 to be explicit.

deploy-bot: pinned chart and image for payments-service in eu-west. Next scheduled promotion will be skipped until manual unpin. (reaction :lock:)

jamie: rollback completed — helm history shows release 4 -> rollback to 3, pods stable and Ready=3/3.

oliver: created PR #4323 with release notes and migration checklist. cc @product for customer messaging.

sara: product reviewed and OK with blurb. Please ensure postmortem links to the migration PR and the templater fix.

jamie: moving discussion to #postmortems to capture timeline and RCA. Closing this rollout thread. Thanks everyone :pray:
